title: Mastercard Foundation Associates Program (12-month paid work placements across Africa)
organization: Mastercard Foundation, with partner organisations (Talenteum for remote roles; Talent2Africa for Francophone Africa; Youth Employment Service; LEAP Africa and others)
overview: A 12-month paid internship placement for young Africans after graduation, with employability training and mentorship, run through partner platforms by region. The official page says applications are open to Mastercard Foundation alumni and young people across Africa, who apply for roles in their country of residence or for remote roles; the Francophone Africa route is marked closed.
program_dates: 12-month placements; roles are posted on an ongoing basis
deadline_text: No closing date on the official page: 'Roles will be posted on an ongoing basis.' The Francophone Africa route shows 'Closed for Applications'.
funding_details: Official page: 'A stipend is provided for the duration of the internship.' No amount is stated on the page read (aggregators quote about USD 300 a month, which varies by location)
No travel, relocation, visa or accommodation support is mentioned; remote roles need no relocation
participation_fee: None mentioned on the pages read
stipend: Provided for the 12 months; the amount is not stated on the official page
eligibility: 'Applications are open to Mastercard Foundation Alumni and young people across Africa'
Apply for roles based only in your country of residence, or for remote roles
Reported by secondary sources, not confirmed on the official page: ages 18 to 35 and 0 to 2 years of work experience
nationality_requirements: Young people across Africa; the DRC is not named on the page read
age_requirement: Not stated on the official page read (aggregators report 18 to 35)
education_requirement: Post-graduation placement; the level is not stated on the page read
experience_requirement: Not stated on the official page read (aggregators report 0 to 2 years)
application_process: Choose the regional portal that matches your country of residence, or the remote-roles portal (Talenteum), from the official page
The Francophone Africa portal (Talent2Africa) shows 'Closed for Applications' on the official page; roles are posted on an ongoing basis

eligibility_reason: The programme is for young Africans after graduation and the profile is a 2024 graduate with under a year of experience. The official page does not state the age or experience rules or name the DRC; whether a DRC resident can use the remote roles, now that the Francophone route is closed, is not confirmed.
potential_issues: The Francophone Africa route (Talent2Africa) is marked 'Closed for Applications' on the official page
Age and experience rules and the stipend amount come from secondary sources only; the official FAQ could not be reached
The DRC is not named on the pages read; applicants must apply for roles in their country of residence or remote roles
The placement is an internship stipend, not a scholarship: no relocation support is mentioned
benefits: Employability training, mentorship and career transition support
relevance_reason: A paid year of work experience would fill the gap that blocks several scholarships in this database (two years of experience), but DRC access and the stipend amount are unconfirmed.

visa.required: Not applicable for remote roles; unknown for in-country roles elsewhere

upfront_cost_risk: Low: no fee mentioned; use only the official partner portals
action: Open the official page and the remote-roles portal (Talenteum) to see whether DRC residents can apply, and re-check the Francophone Africa route (Talent2Africa), which shows closed today. A paid year of experience would also count towards the two-year work rules of several scholarships.
notes: Found through a web search on 2 November 2026; the official Mastercard Foundation pages were read. The Associates programme page lists these partners: Youth Employment Service, Shortlist Futures, Talent 2 Africa, Talenteum, Light for the World, LifeHikes, Leap Africa, KPMG and Coburwas International Youth Organisation to Transform Africa.
